title: GET /menus/v3/metadata answers {restaurantGuid, lastUpdated}, and lastUpdated is the value the full menu document carries

source.note: The Metadata schema has restaurantGuid and lastUpdated, the latter marking the newest publish timestamp of the menu data, meant as the signal callers poll to decide whether to pull a fresh copy -- the same definition Restaurant.lastUpdated carries, which is why the second step asserts the captured value against the full document. That equality is inferred from the two identical definitions; no sentence states it. apiMenusV3.html answered 403 to every fetch this session.
